main_text.p: iam ex parte, quatenus ministri sunt potestati civili subjectos esse debere. Et dub. V. p. 1085. 1086. probat ex Rom. 13. cap. Ecclesiasticos circa bonum spirituale debere Magistratui subjectos esse; & ad exceptionem Stapletoni dicentis Ecclesiasticos quatenus tales, hoc est, quatenus potestatem spiritualem habent, non subjici Regi, sed tantum ut homines & cives Reipub. respondet; Licet Ecclesiastici ut sunt tales, non pendeant à civili potestate suprema simpliciter, quantum ad genus doctrinae & sacramentorum peragendum, tamen pendent ab eâ secundum quid, ratione vocationis, directionis & censurae ut mox patebit. Sic igitur etiam verba Chrysostomi intelligenda, &c. Et Cl Rivetus in Decal. p. 265. postquam dixisset Magistratus quidem pasci ministerio Pastorum, sed tamen vicissim ipsum pascere eos imperio addit: Minister enim cùm doctrinae radiis illuminat, cum Baptismo tingit, cùm salutari Sacramento alit, cum censurae aculeos in contumaces exerit, hæc omnia facit

page.notes: The head "XII." stands in the running head with a fleuron before it; not a heading. Italic and roman runs inside the paragraph were judged from the scan and may be slightly off at word boundaries. Printed hyphens at line ends were joined (post-quam, pa-sci, vi-cissim, il-luminat, sa-lutari, a-culeos). The page ends mid-sentence at "facit", so the text continues on the next page. No catchword or signature visible.
